map.输入源频率 f、相对速度 v 与光速 c，求观测频率（近似非相对论）。: Enter source frequency f, relative velocity v and the speed of light c to get the observed frequency (non-relativistic approximation).

map.光学多普勒效应：观测频率 f prime = f*(1 + v/c)，v 为光源: The optical Doppler effect: observed frequency f prime = f*(1 + v/c), where v is the relative velocity between source and observer (positive when receding, negative when approaching) and c is the speed of light; the shift is Δf = f prime − f = f*v/c; the fractional shift Δf/f = v/c is used in laser velocimetry and astronomical redshift measurement.
map.天体视向速度（红移/蓝移）估算。: Estimating the radial velocity of celestial objects (redshift/blueshift).
map.激光测速、相干雷达频移计算。: Laser velocimetry and coherent radar frequency shift calculations.
map.光源运动对观测频率的影响。: Effect of source motion on the observed frequency.
map.接近光速为何用此近似？: Why use this approximation when speeds approach light?
map.v≪c 时用经典近似 f′=f(1+v/c)；高速须用相对论纵向多普勒公式。: When v≪c the classical approximation f′=f(1+v/c) applies; at high speed the relativistic longitudinal Doppler formula is required.
map.红移蓝移怎么区分？: How do you tell redshift from blueshift?
map.远离（v>0 背离）频率降低为红移，趋近频率升高为蓝移。: Receding (v>0, moving apart) lowers the frequency and gives redshift; approaching raises it and gives blueshift.
